about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Blessed Virgin Mary of the Rosary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May the prayers of Your most holy Mother, whose Rosary we are honoring, help us, we beseech You, O Lord, that we may derive strength from the mysteries we celebrate and obtain benefit from the sacrament we have received. You live and reign with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.
